summary: Iteration 4 JWT auth testing: 25/27 backend auth tests passed. Frontend login/logout/RBAC nav/Users page/CONNECTION tab all verified working. Two real backend bugs found: (1) POST /api/settings/test-email missing require_admin guard — engineers can trigger SMTP test emails; (2) brute-force lockout broken behind k8s multi-replica ingress because identifier uses request.client.host which rotates across proxy IPs (10.219.1.134, 10.219.5.108 observed) so per-email failure count is split and never reaches threshold.

critical.issue: Missing Depends(require_admin). Engineer-role user successfully invokes endpoint (returns 400 'SMTP host not configured' instead of 403). Spec lists this as an admin-only endpoint.

Brute-force lockout never triggers behind k8s ingress. Identifier is f'{request.client.host}:{email}' but request.client.host is the ingress controller IP which rotates between multiple replicas (observed 10.219.1.134 and 10.219.5.108 alternating across 7 sequential login attempts). Each replica IP separately accumulates <5 failures and never hits LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD. Brute-force protection is effectively disabled in this deployment.

minor.issue: Lockout identifier may also be circumvented by attackers naturally — recommend keying by email-only (or email + normalised X-Forwarded-For first hop) and adding a per-account counter.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking the server-card-<id> element itself does not navigate; navigation only happens when the nested <a href=/servers/...> link is clicked directly. Not blocking (link works) but UX is inconsistent — entire card visually looks clickable.

issues: No data-testid='ssh-config-panel' on the panel root — panel renders fine and individual fields are visible, but a top-level testid would help future automation.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Add `_: dict = Depends(require_admin)` to POST /api/settings/test-email handler (server.py line ~1123).

FIX (HIGH): Brute-force identifier must not rely on request.client.host alone behind k8s ingress. Either (a) key by email-only, or (b) parse X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP first hop, or (c) maintain a separate per-account fail counter. Document the chosen mitigation.
MINOR: Add data-testid='ssh-config-panel' to root of SshConfigPanel for testability.

MINOR: Prior iteration test suites (test_iteration3.py, test_new_features.py) now 401 because auth is enforced — update them to login via the admin_session fixture, or accept those suites are superseded by test_iteration4_auth.py.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/settings/test-email is missing require_admin guard — confirmed via live engineer-session call returning 400 instead of 403. Compare with PUT /api/settings which DOES have require_admin.

Brute-force protection uses request.client.host which is the ingress proxy IP behind k8s — practically ineffective. Mongo logs show alternating 10.219.x.x IPs for the same client browser/curl session.

_set_auth_cookies uses secure=False — fine for preview/HTTP but for production HTTPS this should be configurable via env (COOKIE_SECURE=true) otherwise the secure flag never gets set even on https deployments.
JWT_SECRET is read at every request via _jwt_secret() rather than cached at import time — minor perf nit but acceptable.

PATCH /api/users/{id} last-admin guard checks role==engineer OR active==False AND target.role==admin, but does NOT re-check after the update if multiple admins are being demoted in parallel. Race condition is theoretical but exists. Consider a transactional check or unique index trick.
server.py now ~1273 lines (exceeded 700 guideline again) — auth module should be split into /app/backend/auth.py with routers/dependencies/helpers.

auth_router is registered AFTER api_router/public_router include — works because prefix is /api/auth and api_router uses /api with auth dep, but /api/auth/setup must NOT require auth (it doesn't because it's on auth_router without dependencies). Ordering is fine but easy to break — recommend a comment.

success_rate.backend: 25/27 (92.6%) — 2 real backend bugs: test-email RBAC + brute-force ineffective behind ingress
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows — login redirect, valid/invalid login, admin nav links (USERS+SETTINGS+LOGOUT visible), user-badge shows email+role, Users page renders, CONNECTION tab + SshConfigPanel render correctly, logout clears auth

rca_of_the_issue:
Bug 1 RCA: server.py:1122 @api_router.post('/settings/test-email') has no `_: dict = Depends(require_admin)` parameter, while sibling admin endpoints (PUT /settings, POST /seed/reset, POST /servers) do. Likely an oversight when iteration 4 added the role guards. Fix: add `, _: dict = Depends(require_admin)` to test_email() signature.

Bug 2 RCA: server.py:709 `ident = f"{request.client.host if request.client else 'na'}:{email}"`. Under k8s ingress with multiple controller replicas, request.client.host is the per-pod proxy IP which load-balances across pods. Mongo login_attempts collection showed alternating IPs (10.219.1.134, 10.219.5.108) for the same external client. _is_locked_out() filters by identifier exact match so each proxy-pod accumulates <5 entries. Mitigation: use email-only identifier (simplest), or parse X-Forwarded-For first hop, or add a separate per-account failure counter on the user document with TTL.
